Create a free Tuya Cloud project
SwitchGuard reads your devices through Tuya\'s official cloud API with your own free project. It takes about five minutes.
On platform.tuya.com create a free account, then Cloud → Create Cloud Project: Development method "Smart Home", data center = your Smart Life account region (Europe / Türkiye: Central Europe).
In the project: Devices → Link App Account → Add App Account, and scan the QR code with the Smart Life / Tuya app.

Message Service tab: enable it (AES-GCM). Messaging Rules → Production Environment → Create: pick devicePropertyMessage, deviceOnline and deviceOffline, tap Release Rule — then switch the rule ON. Without this, changes arrive only every few minutes.
Copy the Access ID and Access Secret from the project\'s Overview page into the next step.

The free Tuya Cloud trial must be extended now and then (Cloud → IoT Core → Extend trial period); SwitchGuard warns you when it expires. Devices that were only shared with you may not appear — ask the owner to add you as a home member.
